name: Classic Balsamic Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: finely chopped shallot, from 1 small shallot

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, whisk together vinegar, shallot, garlic, salt, and pepper. Let mixture sit for 10 minutes. Whisk in Dijon and honey, then gradually whisk in oil in a steady stream to form an emulsified vinaigrette. Use immediately or refrigerate in an airtight container until ready to use, whisking or shaking vigorously if the vinaigrette has separated.

schema_metadata.keywords: balsamic vinaigrette, balsamic vinaigrette recipe, homemade balsamic vinaigrette, balsamic dressing, balsamic salad dressing, easy balsamic vinaigrette, classic balsamic vinaigrette

description: This easy balsamic vinaigrette is bright, balanced, and just sweet enough, with shallot, garlic, Dijon, honey, and extra-virgin olive oil.
notes: Make-ahead and storage: This dressing can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 7 days.
author: Laila Ibrahim
